article.title: Local 221 Ratifies Contract Amidst Federal Cuts
article.content: At the end of September, UE Local 221 members who work for the Head Start program at Northeast Kingdom Community Action (NEKCA) ratified a two-year contract that includes wage increases and improvements to language. The benefits in the contract were won despite $1.2 million of federal funding cut to the Head Start program. The members won a $250 one-time stipend for full-time employees and a $100 stipend for part-time employees. The contract includes a 1.5 percent wage increase and the option for members to negotiate future cost-of-living adjustments during the life of the contract. The members also won layoff protections — extending the layoff recall list from 12 to 18 months for employees with one to three years of service. The bargaining team consisted of Kelli Arkley , Deborah Brousseau , Nancy McBey , and Julia Tucker . They were assisted by International Representative Sherry Bryant .
